mentions.name: Tech Talks Weekly
mentions.description: This newsletter sends a weekly email aggregating all talk recordings uploaded in the past 7 days from nearly every software engineering conference. Each issue features must-watch highlighted talks with a short human-written video summary, plus a complete list of new talks grouped by conference and ordered by view count. It also periodically publishes talk compilations, such as the 50 and 100 most-watched software engineering talks.
